title: Tracelite workload-summary insight guard
impact: Adds a Resqlite-side validation step to `benchmark/profile/run_tracelite_profile.dart` so canonical profile runs fail if `tracelite explain` regresses to coverage-only output. The validated profile emitted dispatch floors, dispatch-bound point queries, work-bound merge rounds, tail spread, RSS, allocation, and WAL insight IDs; thin `workload_loaded` fixtures now fail locally
